name: News Ticker
project_description:
Back to top 

 Introduction 
 News Ticker provides a configurable scrolling news ticker for supported Drupal 10.6 and Drupal 11.3+ sites.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Validated news lists and items with hardened access and error handling. 
 A reusable block with responsive layout, keyboard focus behavior, pause controls, and reduced-motion support. 
 Administrator-only design controls for colors, typography, spacing, speed, icons, and layout. 
 Optional custom CSS declarations protected by a strict allowlist sanitizer; selectors, at-rules, external resources, executable values, escapes, and !important are rejected. 
 Automated functional/unit tests and PHP, JavaScript, CSS, spelling, Composer, and supported-version CI on every push. 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Drupal 10.6 or Drupal 11.3 and later.
